create_rank_to_trace_dict_from_dir: create a rank to trace file dictionary from a directory of trace files
create_rank_to_trace_dict: create a rank to trace file dictionary from a list of trace file paths
read_trace: read a compressed JSON trace file and return its parsed data as a dictionary
write_trace: write trace data dictionary to a compressed JSON trace file on disk
update_trace_rank: update the distributed rank value in an existing trace file
